title: Enterprise Connectivity: minimum invoice amount
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following minimum invoice amount for each named contract tier. Minimum positive monthly invoice total; USD decimal, smaller totals carry forward.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | minimum invoice amount | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | minimum invoice amount | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | minimum invoice amount | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | minimum invoice amount | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | minimum invoice amount | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | minimum invoice amount | 0.5 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the minimum invoice amount is 0.5.
